# Relational fidelity of comparison content: minimum requirements, grouping and real loss

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

On one Frame with its process unchanged, claims are regrouped many-to-one. Recovering each original realization is exactly constancy within each group at that configuration; fidelity at both configurations preserves the existing Extension comparison. Equal Web requirements and thresholds supply fidelity; with decidable requirements, fidelity on all level paths holds iff group members have equal pointwise minimum requirements at every step, zero on unrequired conditions. The inherited Transfer moving/withholding paths are generated from one start and one rest-law, both feasible and balanced; real mixed gains and losses remain although merging differently dependent formations makes the grouped readings identical.

Canonical source: [Regrouping.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Regrouping.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The shared Frame and its supplied claim interpretation; grouping changes the reading only. The extension instance counts every claim.
- Comparison fidelity uses within-group agreement at both compared configurations. This is sufficient, not alleged necessary for every accidentally preserved pairwise verdict.
- The Web instance retains discrete steps, natural levels and needs. The exact all-level minimum-profile characterization additionally takes decidable requirements; the sufficient equal-requirements form does not.
- The conveyor construction uses the inherited Transfer dependencies and supplied exchange; the rest is inactive in this minimal witness.

AI continuation of Ren’s request to complete this session’s alignment-direction work: contents are read from support and exchange within one unfolding before description and comparison are tested. Minimum requirements characterize admission, not separate value owners, actual identity or complete generative significance.

Equal minimum requirements fix admission only; distinct lives, histories and expressions can have equal needs. Marginal admission does not establish joint realizability, which must itself be represented. All-level tests may include dynamically inaccessible levels and are stronger than local fidelity on feasible courses. Actual dependencies, a unique complete content language, constitution of changing needs, complete mixed-loss ordering and zero-substantive-axiom normative warrant are not derived. No universal lossless-action requirement, institutional-retreat default or new empirical validation is claimed.

- generated_mixed_hidden and merged_not_respects: opposed real changes generated from one start and rest-law disappear into equality under unfaithful grouping. The target is arbitrary grouping fidelity, not the full relational account.
